value.answer: I'd go with the Honda Odyssey. U.S. News has it #1 at 9.3 out of 10, Car Talk's staff picked it too, and Edmunds says drivers like it most of all. The rankings don't agree on a single winner, though. Edmunds has the Toyota Sienna #1, and that's the one to get if fuel economy matters most, at 36 mpg combined. This is for the U.S. market.
